set.q: Which sentence correctly says that one library is near the park?
o: There are a library near the park.
There is a library near the park.
There have a library near the park.
It are a library near the park.
set.why: 단수 명사 앞에는 There is를 써요. 'have'는 '있다'는 뜻의 There 구문에 쓰지 않아요.

patches.why: Distractor "It has a library near the park." is grammatical and can be read as a second correct answer (e.g. a town has a library); replaced with a clearly wrong form. q/o identity text changes.

set.q: Choose the best answer to "Are there any buses to the airport at night?"

patches.why: "No, there isn't." is commonly said by native speakers in reply to "Are there any buses...?" so it is defensible; replaced with a clearly wrong form.
